```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4)
```

```{r load-data}
pd   <- params$patient_data
traj <- params$trajectory
tx   <- params$treatment_phases
dps  <- params$decision_pts
flab <- params$focus_lab

lab_labels <- c(
  ck = "CK", aldolase = "Aldolase", ast = "AST", alt = "ALT",
  ldh = "LDH", esr = "ESR", crp = "CRP",
  anti_jo1 = "Anti-Jo-1", anti_mi2 = "Anti-Mi-2",
  anti_mda5 = "Anti-MDA5", anti_tif1 = "Anti-TIF1-γ",
  anti_hmgcr = "Anti-HMGCR"
)
lab_label <- lab_labels[flab] %||% toupper(flab)
```

## Patient Overview

```{r overview}
all_dates <- c(pd$labs$measurement_date,
               pd$medications$drug_exposure_start_date)
all_dates <- sort(all_dates[!is.na(all_dates)])
span <- if (length(all_dates) >= 2)
  round(as.numeric(diff(range(all_dates))) / 365.25, 1)
else NA_real_

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Domain       = c("Lab results", "Medications (unique)",
                   "Hospital visits", "Conditions",
                   "Clinical notes", "Follow-up (years)"),
  Count        = c(
    nrow(pd$labs),
    length(unique(pd$medications$drug_name[!is.na(pd$medications$drug_name)])),
    nrow(pd$visits),
    length(unique(pd$conditions$condition_source_value[
      !is.na(pd$conditions$condition_source_value)])),
    nrow(pd$notes),
    if (!is.na(span)) span else "—"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(summary_df, col.names = c("Domain", "Count"),
             align = c("l", "r"))
```

## Trajectory Phases — `r lab_label`

```{r traj-plot, fig.height=3.5}
if (!is.null(traj) && nrow(traj) > 0) {
  PHASE_COLORS <- c(
    flare = "#C62828", worsening = "#EF6C00", stable = "#2E7D32",
    response = "#0277BD", relapse = "#6A1B9A", sparse = "#9E9E9E"
  )
  # Simple base-R plot
  uln_val <- .get_default_uln(flab)

  # Filter focus lab
  ld <- pd$labs[!is.na(pd$labs$value_as_number) &
                !is.na(pd$labs$measurement_date), ]
  lab_ids <- .resolve_lab_concept(flab)
  if (!is.null(lab_ids) && "measurement_concept_id" %in% names(ld)) {
    ld <- ld[ld$measurement_concept_id %in% lab_ids, ]
  }

  if (nrow(ld) > 0) {
    old_par <- par(mar = c(3, 4, 1, 1))
    y_max <- max(ld$value_as_number, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
    plot(ld$measurement_date, ld$value_as_number,
         type = "n", xlab = "", ylab = paste(lab_label, "(U/L)"),
         ylim = c(0, y_max), xaxt = "n", bty = "l")
    axis.Date(1, ld$measurement_date, format = "%b %Y", cex.axis = 0.8)

    # Phase bands
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(traj))) {
      ph  <- traj$phase[i]
      col <- PHASE_COLORS[ph]
      if (is.na(col)) col <- "#BDBDBD"
      rect(traj$window_start[i], 0, traj$window_end[i], y_max,
           col = paste0(col, "22"), border = NA)
    }

    if (!is.na(uln_val)) abline(h = uln_val, lty = 2, col = "#9E9E9E", lwd = 1.2)

    points(ld$measurement_date, ld$value_as_number,
           pch = 16, col = "#3D6FD4", cex = 0.9)

    if (nrow(ld) >= 4L) {
      lo <- tryCatch(
        stats::loess(value_as_number ~ as.numeric(measurement_date),
                     data = ld, span = 0.4),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(lo)) {
        xs <- seq(min(ld$measurement_date), max(ld$measurement_date), by = "7 days")
        ys <- tryCatch(stats::predict(lo,
          newdata = data.frame(measurement_date = as.numeric(xs))),
          error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(ys)) lines(xs, ys, col = "#3D6FD4", lwd = 2)
      }
    }

    legend("topright", legend = names(PHASE_COLORS),
           fill = paste0(PHASE_COLORS, "44"), border = PHASE_COLORS,
           cex = 0.65, ncol = 3, bty = "n")
    par(old_par)
  } else {
    cat("No lab values available for", lab_label)
  }
} else {
  cat("No trajectory phases computed.")
}
```

```{r traj-table}
if (!is.null(traj) && nrow(traj) > 0) {
  out <- traj[, c("window_start","window_end","phase","confidence",
                  "mean_value","n_obs"), drop = FALSE]
  out$mean_value <- round(out$mean_value, 1)
  names(out) <- c("Start","End","Phase","Confidence","Mean Value","N Obs")
  knitr::kable(out, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = paste(lab_label, "trajectory phase segments"))
}
```

## Treatment Timeline

```{r tx-table}
if (!is.null(tx) && nrow(tx) > 0) {
  out_tx <- tx[, c("drug_name","drug_family","phase_start","phase_end",
                   "n_days","n_records"), drop = FALSE]
  names(out_tx) <- c("Drug","Family","Start","End","Days","Records")
  out_tx <- out_tx[order(out_tx$Start), ]
  knitr::kable(out_tx, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Treatment episodes")
}
```

---

## Decision Points

```{r dp-table}
if (!is.null(dps) && nrow(dps) > 0) {
  out_dp <- dps[, c("date","event_type","label","confidence","source_domain"),
                drop = FALSE]
  out_dp$event_type <- gsub("_", " ", tools::toTitleCase(out_dp$event_type))
  names(out_dp) <- c("Date","Type","Description","Confidence","Source")
  knitr::kable(out_dp, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Clinical decision points")
} else {
  cat("No decision points detected.")
}
```

## Hospitalizations

```{r visits-table}
if (nrow(pd$visits) > 0) {
  v_cols <- intersect(c("visit_start_date","visit_end_date","visit_type",
                         "discharge_disposition"), names(pd$visits))
  out_v  <- pd$visits[, v_cols, drop = FALSE]
  out_v  <- out_v[order(out_v$visit_start_date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  knitr::kable(out_v, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Visit history")
} else {
  cat("No visit records.")
}
```
